gloss: abandoned dog; stray dog that has been abandoned by its owner

definitions.gloss: abandoned dog; dog that has been thrown away by its owner
definitions.explanation: A pet dog that has been abandoned by its owner — left on a street, dumped in the countryside, or tied up outside a shelter. The term emphasizes the owner's act of abandoning the animal and carries a strongly negative emotional charge; it is the standard word used in discussions of pet welfare and adoption.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found an abandoned dog in the park.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}で{捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}を{引|ひ}き{取|と}ることにした。
examples.english: Our family decided to take in an abandoned dog.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{夏|なつ}になると、{旅行|りょこう}{先|さき}などで{捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}にされるケースが{増|ふ}えると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Every year when summer comes, it is said that cases of dogs being abandoned — at travel destinations and so on — increase.

notes:
Compound of the verb stem {捨|す}て (from {捨|す}てる, "to throw away, abandon") and {犬|いぬ} (dog). The verb stem acts as a modifier meaning "thrown away," so {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ} is literally "a thrown-away dog." The parallel word {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ} exists for cats.

The word distinguishes animals that were someone's pet and then abandoned from other kinds of strays; a dog born in the wild would more naturally be {野犬|やけん} (wild/feral dog) rather than {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}. Because abandoning a pet is a crime in Japan under the Animal Welfare Act, the term often appears in news stories and animal-welfare campaigns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}を{拾|ひろ}う: to pick up an abandoned dog
- {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}を{保護|ほご}する: to rescue an abandoned dog
- {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}を{引|ひ}き{取|と}る: to take in an abandoned dog
- {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}にする: to abandon a dog
- {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}を{減|へ}らす: to reduce the number of abandoned dogs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}: abandoned cat — the parallel word for cats
- {野良犬|のらいぬ}: stray dog — broader; a dog living on the streets regardless of origin
- {野犬|やけん}: feral/wild dog — a dog never socialized as a pet
- {保護犬|ほごけん}: rescue dog — a dog currently being cared for at a shelter, often a former {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}: lost dog — a dog that is missing, not intentionally abandoned
